question: is the per-swath constant biased by the scan angles the tile samples, and does that explain the elba/elbaext disagreement?

inputs.role: elba_fulldensity gen1 CSF ground returns: per-return scan angle, flight line, grid cell and offset d_mm to the gen2 reference
elba_fulldensity pipeline corrections: the saved per-swath alignment
elbaext gen1 CSF ground returns: per-return scan angle, flight line, grid cell and offset d_mm to the gen2 reference
elbaext pipeline corrections: the saved per-swath alignment

params.name: shared_swaths
params.why: the flight lines both Elba products align; data/derived/{elba_fulldensity,elbaext}/corrections*.json

params.name: compare_reference_swath
params.why: elba's own align_swaths reference (min point_source_id); MISSION_TIME_DRIFT.md section 4 re-references elbaext to it

columns.n_returns: CSF ground returns of that swath inside the tile, count
columns.scan_mean: mean SIGNED scan angle of those returns, deg (0 = nadir)
columns.scan_med: median signed scan angle of those returns, deg
columns.edge: adjacent swath pair, as coregister_swaths solves it
columns.n_cells: grid cells the pair shares -- the overlap strip the pair is solved on
columns.scan_a: mean signed scan angle of the LOWER-numbered line inside the strip, deg
columns.scan_b: mean signed scan angle of the HIGHER-numbered line inside the strip, deg
columns.asym: scan_b - scan_a: the across-track sampling asymmetry of the edge, deg
columns.ref: swath pinned to zero by the gauge
columns.rel_max_mm: largest change in any swath-to-swath DIFFERENCE against the zero-mean solve, mm
columns.abs_shift_mm: the constant the gauge subtracts from every swath, mm
columns.variant: which vertical registration the per-swath constants were chained from
columns.d136: elbaext minus elba constant for swath 136, referenced to 135, mm
columns.rms_mm: RMS of those three disagreements, mm (the pinned swath is a gauge, not an observation, so it is excluded -- as in MISSION_TIME_DRIFT.md section 4)
columns.b_mm_per_deg: pooled across-track slope from boresight.estimate_boresight, mm per degree of scan angle
columns.b_pair_std: std of the per-pair slopes -- the honest uncertainty on b

headline: reference swath is a pure gauge (relative solution invariant); across-track sampling is real on the outermost edge only and accounts for 9.3->5.1 mm RMS of the elba/elbaext disagreement
